decisions.decision: Commission agreed the Mass 1 pipe repair should be done as soon as possible, before cold weather.
decisions.quote: commission discussed and agreed it should be done as soon as possible.

decisions.decision: No new Commission vote is needed on the Special Town Meeting article; the earlier vote covers it.
decisions.quote: bill added that a new vote is not needed.

decisions.decision: Once the Commission approved the Mass 1 work, the DPW Director was to contact CTE to proceed.
decisions.quote: once the commission approves, bill will contact cte to get things going.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission received ARPA federal money to repair manholes showing inflow and infiltration.
budget_items.quote: bill stated that the town was given arpa federal money and the commission received $100k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: CTE's estimate for the rotted pipe repair at Mass 1, plus pumping trucks, totals around $70K; an emergency repair would cost about triple.
budget_items.quote: the cost estimate is $66,770 plus $2-3k for the pumping trucks for a total around $70k.

budget_items.topic: Cost of emergency repair at Mass 1
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Brett said an emergency burst of the high-pressure line would be quite expensive, probably triple the planned cost; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: dealing with it if it burst as an emergency would be quite expensive--probably triple the cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: CTE's second job to repair the inlet pipes at the Mass 1 pumps costs $64,625.
budget_items.quote: the cost will be $64,625 and cte has also hired pride environmental to do the repair.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY24 ended with revenues exceeding expenses by about $46K.
budget_items.quote: paula found out that fy24 ended with revenues exceeding expenses by about $46k.

budget_items.topic: FY24 budget result and connection fees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Higher betterments and connection fees produced the FY24 surplus; connection fees rose in July after rate increases in Fitchburg and Leominster. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the rates in fitchburg and leominster went up, causing lunenburg to significantly increase connection fees in july.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY25 budget is described as looking ok, with the Mass 1 repairs planned for in the budget. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: bill added that the fy25 budget is looking ok right now and the repairs at mass 1 were planned for in the budget.

transfers.outcome: Proposed as a Special Town Meeting article; the minutes state no new Commission vote is needed.
